candidates.change_summary: Replace increment of imBalances[to] by creditsIssued with increment of imBalances[msg.sender], causing credits to be attributed to caller rather than specified recipient.
Replace increment of imBalances[to] by creditsIssued with increment of imBalances[to] by mAssetAmount (using underlying amount instead of credits), changing stored units.
Replace increment of imBalances[to] by creditsIssued with a decrement, subtracting creditsIssued (causing balances to decrease instead of increase).
Delete the statement that updates imBalances[to], leaving balances unchanged after supply.
Modify nonReentrant modifier to omit the reentrancy guard check (remove require), allowing reentrant calls which can alter imBalances via nested supplyTokenTo calls.
